limits: These are data/functional checks, not measured Adobe UI or rendering parity.
Storage-only fixtures are explicitly not used as codec/media evidence. Codec fixtures are genuine procedural editable PNG16/TIFF16 files.
Backup restore is exercised through its storage API. Current user changes removed its visible dialog; this audit does not reintroduce that UI or certify a user-facing backup workflow.
Arbitrary ICC transforms, wide-gamut/HDR interpretation and missing codecs remain unsupported. Rejecting those inputs is not feature parity.
TIFF exporter currently writes RGB, not an alpha channel; alpha preservation is verified for PNG16 output only.
Potential non-square straightening distortion from normalized-coordinate transforms is UNVERIFIED; no aspect-correct rotation/pixel parity claim is made.
Browser matrix testing is of installed engines, not proof of current stable browser coverage.
No original source bytes or immutable Adobe reference images were changed.
